statement: The ticket’s “Event to cancel” field gives EV-4408, Ana Ferreira’s doctoral defence, despite its reason referring to the weekly reading group.
judge_text:
WRONG
It asserts the event ID in the record contradicts the stated reason — "gives EV-4408, Ana Ferreira's doctoral defence, despite its reason referring to the weekly reading group."
